entries.name: nx
entries.description: s1ngularity supply-chain attack (Aug 2025): compromised Nx build system versions that abused installed AI coding CLIs to search for and steal secrets.

entries.name: postmark-mcp
entries.description: Unofficial MCP server impersonating Postmark. From version 1.0.16 it silently BCC'd every e-mail sent through it to an attacker address (Sep 2025).
